format_notes.scope: Portable unit/integration fixture contracts: tree input payload uses actual SemanticNode/HydratedTextPointer field names; mock workflow scripts are adapter-neutral and require repository-specific test-double wiring. Not provider API request schemas.
format_notes.terminal_ownership: every non-whitespace source character exactly once in leaf total_content_pointers; wrappers/aggregate pointers do not count
format_notes.tree_cases_support: input_tree may intentionally violate invariants; tests must check expected outcome, no silent repair/data loss
format_notes.illustrative_normalized_tree: one acceptable exact normalization for pure tree tests, not a required canonical node type or ID across public parsing implementations
format_notes.model_validation: Use SemanticNode.model_validate(...) in repository where available. For invalid-pointer cases constructibility is intended; call final semantic integrity and terminal coverage gate.
format_notes.workflow_scripts: stage/kind/script are fixture test-harness instructions, not KG Doc Parser production JSON schema.

tree_cases.description: Title + one indivisible table must yield two grounded leaves; table stays atomic.
Generic content-parent → atomic-child, not a special heading case.
Generic section → single figure source-preserving morphism.
Contentless wrappers can be promoted only without dropping children, pointers or source.
Unary content parent with nested grandchildren must preserve all grandchildren; atomic_retained may not discard rows.

tree_cases.description: No phantom sibling for source-only doc; promote safely if schema permits, otherwise reject explicitly.
Display labels with no independent source span must not be materialized as invented leaves.
Exercise non-recursive shape gate and verify 70 unary wrappers are not accepted unchanged.
Repeated identical strings at different source positions are not duplicates.
Two terminal nodes claim same span; source owner metric must reject even though tree branches.
Valid tree shape does not permit missing table or duplicated source ownership; no denominator shrink.
Incorrect verbatim_text must fail grounding despite correct numeric offsets.
Char offsets are Python-character indices and end_char is inclusive, even with Unicode and CRLF.
Normalized-text duplicates must not erase two distinct source positions.
A long table is still allowed as ONE atomic table. No forced row segmentation to satisfy minimum branching.
Two grounded children is valid and must remain valid without changing identity.
Parent pointer contains child span: compute only exclusive source ownership or explicitly reject; no duplicate terminal ownership.
Even with correct shape and complete coverage, mismatched parent IDs must be rejected.

workflow_cases.description: Unary LLM proposal invokes CUD and is corrected inside finite budget.
Repeated unary corrections exhaust budget: reject original strategy; no atomic_retained laundering.

PageIndex fallback subdivides one layer only; workflow owns subsequent parsing.
Provider-configured auto path invokes a triage model once per eligible frontier.
Provider failure cannot be mislabeled as successful LLM triage.
Repeated PageIndex LLM calls must hit response cache without skipping validation.
Cache invalidates on source, contract, provider changes, tenant isolation.
Restarted standalone run must restore committed frontier and meet same invariants.
Source revision mismatch invalidates checkpoint and prior cache entries.
